entities.title: Only the everyday subset of operations
entities.summary: The library implements validation, the everyday API of docs/everyday-api.md, the text form and .NET interop; nothing else of docs/operations.md.
entities.impact: convert, expand, equivalent and the other operations of docs/operations.md are absent; so are canonical JSON round-tripping and writing, other calendars, zones beyond a supplied bundle, recurrences, and semantic validation of any kind other than Gregorian civil dates.

relationships.description: The milestones that would add them.

entities.title: No conformance profile claimed
entities.summary: The README and the package description claim no conformance profile (core-civil, zoned, …).
entities.impact: Under VERSIONING.md the library cannot reach 1.0.0 until it passes the structural material and every semantic scenario of the profiles it claims.

entities.title: Semantic scenarios are not run
entities.summary: conformance/scenarios/*.json are not executable yet (OI-12), and the tests do not run them.
entities.impact: Nothing checks this library against the 94 semantic scenarios.

entities.title: No registries ship with the library
entities.summary: No tzdb, leap-second table or non-Gregorian calendar is included; zone rules are passed in as a ZoneRules bundle.
entities.impact: Zone operations work only for the zones and years of the bundle the caller supplies; the repository's demo bundle covers New York, Paris and Reykjavik for 2026 and 2027.
entities.workaround: Supply a bundle in the demo-zones.json format with the zones and years needed.
